findings.title: v3 plaintext→encrypted migration that used to fail loudly now runs and drops populated column data
findings.label: valid
findings.note: At base, migration.ts had no sweep and the regex ignored v3, so plaintext->v3 failed at migrate. At head it is silently rewritten into ADD/DROP/RENAME with only comment and info-level warnings and no non-empty-table guard.

findings.title: Encrypted→encrypted type change (v2→v3 or v3 domain swap) rewritten into a DROP of the ciphertext column
findings.label: valid
findings.note: The base regex matched only eql_v2_encrypted, so a v2->v3 or v3->v3 ALTER went through unchanged or failed loudly. At head it is rewritten to drop the existing ciphertext column, and the cited base/head lines and the ops.json domain DDL support this.
